prompt: Announce Tuesday's HOA meeting on mulch compliance as a WWE event. The chairman's entrance music hits.
response:
**(The arena lights go black. A single spotlight hits the HOA clubhouse podium. The opening riff of "The Chairman’s Gavel" blasts through the PA system at maximum volume. Pyrotechnics erupt from the recycling bins as CHAIRMAN "THE BYLAW ENFORCER" STERLING storms down the aisle, clutching a laminated copy of CC&R Section 4.2 like a championship title belt. He enters the ring, snatches the microphone, and stares intensely into the camera.)**

**CHAIRMAN STERLING:**
CUT THE MUSIC!

*(Feedback screeches. The crowd of homeowners falls dead silent.)*

LISTEN TO ME, AND LISTEN GOOD, SUBDIVISION! For too long, this community has been plagued by WEAKNESS! By DISREGARD! By the UNLAWFUL APPLICATION OF UNAPPROVED BARK NUGGETS IN FRONT-YARD LANDSCAPING BEDS!

You think I don’t see it? You think I don’t know about the rogue cedar mulch on Elm Street?! I SEE EVERYTHING! And this **TUESDAY NIGHT**, at the **RUMBLE IN THE CLUBHOUSE**, there will be NO DISQUALIFICATIONS, NO COUNT-OUTS, and ABSOLUTELY NO EXCEPTIONS FOR NON-COMPLIANT GROUND COVER!

We are talking about a **HARDCORE MULCH COMPLIANCE SUMMIT!**

In one corner: The Approved Vendor List, weighing in at three inches of certified, color-fast, HOA-sanctioned hardwood!
In the other corner: YOUR VIOLATIONS! Your faded pine straw! Your unpermitted rubber tire shreds! Your *cousin’s leftover gravel from 2019!*

AND LET ME TELL YOU SOMETHING, NEIGHBORS… THIS TUESDAY, THE BYLAW ENFORCER IS PUTTING EVERY NON-COMPLIANT LANDSCAPE BED ON NOTICE! If your mulch doesn’t match the approved Pantone color swatch, YOU WILL BE TAPPED OUT! You will receive a NOTICE OF VIOLATION so devastating, so UNDENIABLE, that your property value will FEEL IT FOR GENERATIONS!

**SO MARK YOUR CALENDARS!**

🗓️ **WHEN:** THIS TUESDAY! 7:00 PM SHARP!
